## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +42.17%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and HYG (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND with LQD (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND, plus SPY (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -7.76%) vs TLT (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -4.81%) BELOW TREND, confirm risk-off.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +42.17%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Credit stress worsening: HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -0.25% | 1M: -2.16% / LQD 1W: -0.21% | 1M: -3.34%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds down: SPY/TLT (SPY 1W: -2.23% | 1M: -7.76% / TLT 1W: -0.22% | 1M: -4.81%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Tightening: TLT (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -4.81%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve → flat (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -4.74%) BELOW TREND; Dollar Strength ↑ rising (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +14.38%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -7.75%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: XLF (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -9.37%) BELOW TREND — style mixed, no broad growth leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US weak: SPY (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -7.76%) BELOW TREND. Emerging markets underperform: EEM (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -11.98%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -6.79%) BELOW TREND; Europe also soft: FEZ (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -13.40%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation contracting: ARKK (1W: -6.54% | 1M: -13.38%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -5.96% | 1M: -2.25%) BELOW TREND; small caps showing short-term resilience: IWM (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -8.44%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Bifurcated: Oil strong — USO (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +55.70%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: -0.42% | 1M: +55.87%) CORRECTION — while base metals/copper CPER (1W: +3.40% | 1M: -8.93%) RECOVERY and gold GLD (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -13.15%) RECOVERY show safe-haven flows.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy leadership clear: XLE (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +14.38%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +7.91%) CORRECTION with divergence vs oil.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Elevated fear (VXX ↑) and credit deterioration (HYG/LQD ↓) with narrow sector breadth (3/11) support RISK-OFF. DIVERGENCE: commodity ETFs (BNO, UGA, UNG) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — minor divergence, not a core trend break.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor defensive positioning and liquidity; reduce exposure to broad growth/tech ETFs (XLK (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -7.75%) BELOW TREND) and thematic risk (ARKK (1W: -6.54% | 1M: -13.38%) BELOW TREND). Monitor energy (XLE) for tactical exposure while credit metrics remain stressed.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +14.38%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -7.75%) BELOW TREND; XLF (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -9.37%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: USO (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +55.70%) ABOVE TREND; XLE (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +14.38%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: GLD (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -13.15%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -21.14%) RECOVERY remain vulnerable on the month.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~39.4 (elevated fear), SPY/TLT 7.40 (stocks vs bonds) ↓ falling, HYG/LQD ~0.73 (credit stress), XLK/XLF 2.72 (tech vs financials pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive.  
Energy showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND); tech and broad growth showing weakness (XLK BELOW TREND, ARKK BELOW TREND).  
Key risk: rising VXX and deteriorating HYG/LQD with commodity 1W/1M divergences to monitor.
